instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete working application for Prisma — Prompt Intelligence Studio with JavaScript (.js/jsx) files in /app/frontend/src/.
Default the interface language to Indonesian ('id') with instant toggle to English ('en') in the Header.
Implement the 3 core modes: Improve (Pertajam), Refactor (Restrukturisasi), and Brainstorm (Eksplorasi Ide).
In Brainstorm mode, display 3 distinct direction cards with tradeoffs, key benefits, recommended badge, and individual select/combine actions.
Implement server-side/API integration for prompt sharpening with fallback/in-memory AGI reasoning simulation if backend AI service is initializing.
Add philosophical lens dropdown (None, Socratic, First Principles, Epistemic Humility, Pragmatism, Systems Thinking) with strength slider/toggle (Subtle / Explicit).
Add expandable Settings drawer for output language, depth, target audience, tone, and lens strength.
Add follow-up refinement chips ('Buat lebih ringkas', 'Tambah edge cases', 'Format JSON', 'Tone eksekutif', 'Jadikan teknis') + custom input field.
Include diff comparison view (Original vs Refined text), Markdown download, Copy prompt button, and session version history sidebar with restore functionality.
Support clear loading states with step-by-step AGI reasoning progress indicators, empty states with one-click sample prompts, and resilient error states.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based, e.g. data-testid='sharpen-prompt-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use light mode or pure transparent background headers; maintain deep charcoal #0D1117 with glassmorphism backdrop-blur.
Ensure contrast is high between text (#F0F6FC) and background panels (#161B22).
Use Electric Lime (#84CC16) strictly for accents, active states, key CTAs, and glowing highlights.
Never use generic centered layouts or marketing heroes. Keep the workspace accessible immediately upon load.
Add micro-interactions, smooth hover transitions, and keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Cmd+Enter / Ctrl+Enter to sharpen).
Ensure all interactive items have data-testid attributes for testing.
